method: Independent effective overlays, recursive item model/parent/texture resolution against official clients, and exact native metadata plus ZIP/composite resource resolution. Pre-1.21.9 probes also parse every supplied model and available item definition using native deserializers.
scope_notes: Native resource roots include experimental item assets present in the official client; this does not assert normal survival availability before their full introduction.
The modern 1.21.9–26.3 assets remain byte-identical to the reviewed V3 rendering resources; these probes check native metadata and resource resolution plus independent reference graphs.

Minecraft 1.17–1.19.4 reads only root pack_format15 and reports TOO_NEW. The legacy item resources still parse and resolve, but accepting the compatibility warning is required. No older-version in-game visual pass is claimed.
